'''Curtiss Murphy Ties in the Dark''' is a [[Dark]] Shot In The Dark systems list [[Curtiss Murphy]] posted after beating Shot In The Dark Drain decks in sanctioned play.<ref name="list-36982">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/36982 swccg-discussion message #36982], [[Curtiss Murphy]] (1 April 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010508200853/http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/36982 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Curtiss Murphy]]
* '''Published:''' 1 April 1998 (swccg-discussion)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]] (from the card pool)
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel|Premiere-D-kessel.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ties in the Dark
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Ties Murphy DS 1998.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Murphy wrote the list as another use of Shot In The Dark besides the drain deck.

== Strategy ==

Use Shot In The Dark early to occupy systems, then drain in space with TIEs and Star Destroyers. 3,720 To 1 is extra damage.
